name: secrets-mcp
description: MCP server and Claude Code plugin for storing and using secrets, certificates, and private keys without exposing their values to the model
author: DatanoiseTV

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning && chmod +x dist/index.js dist/cli.js
